description: The plot illustrates how overall ROUGE-G score varies with the number of training examples for four summarization models under two training setups (solid lines versus dashed lines labeled “(5%)”). The x-axis is labeled “# Training Examples” on a linear scale with three marked values at 0, 16, and 64. The y-axis is labeled “Overall ROUGE-G Score” on a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 19.0, with evenly spaced tick marks every 2.0 units (11.0, 13.0, 15.0, 17.0, 19.0). The green circle-marked PELMS solid line rises from just under 17 at 0 examples to about 18.4 at 16 and about 18.7 at 64, while the green circle-marked PELMS (5%) dashed line sits near the high-16s at 0 and 16 and increases to just under 18 at 64. The red square-marked Primera solid line increases from about 15.0 at 0 to a bit above 17 at 16 and to a little above 18 at 64, while the red square-marked Primera (5%) dashed line starts around 15.0 at 0, dips to the mid-14s at 16, and returns to the mid-15s by 64. The blue triangle-marked Pegasus-X solid line climbs from the mid-13s at 0 to the mid-15s at 16 and to just under 18 at 64, whereas the blue triangle-marked Pegasus-X (5%) dashed line drops from the mid-13s at 0 to just under 12 at 16 and then increases to around 14 at 64. The yellow diamond-marked Centrum solid line is relatively flat, starting just under 16 at 0, staying near 16 at 16, and reaching the mid-16s at 64, and the yellow diamond-marked Centrum (5%) dashed line stays close to 16 across the x-axis with a slight dip around 16 examples and a return to roughly 16 by 64.
